visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a table overflowing with numerous square red and black trays containing thinly sliced raw meats. A white plate in the foreground holds raw shrimp and clams over green leaves. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a commercial indoor setting. (2) A person's hand enters the frame, using silver chopsticks to pick up a slice of marbled meat and dip it into a small, bubbling stainless steel pot containing a dark brown broth. The pot sits on a black induction cooktop embedded in a speckled stone table. (3) The camera pans across a large buffet area featuring rows of instant noodles, fresh vegetables like pumpkin and carrots, and several large metal soup dispensers. Large hanging banners with orange and blue branding are visible above the counters. (4) A rapid sequence of shots showcases various buffet items: a ladle pouring rich meat sauce onto white rice, bright orange curry sauce, an assortment of colorful fresh vegetables, trays of stir-fried noodles, and a selection of fried foods in a heated glass cabinet. (5) Handheld camera movements follow the person assembling a salad and pouring light brown liquid onto cold noodles. A freezer displays various pudding desserts, while nearby stations offer soft-serve ice cream, shaved ice toppings, and a soda fountain. (6) Returning to the main table, several more trays of different meat cuts (beef, pork, and duck) are shown. Chopsticks lift a particularly well-marbled slice of beef to the camera. (7) A plate of fresh clams is poured into the pot. (8) Wide shots show the restaurant interior, featuring a modern design with grey brick walls, long wooden tables with built-in stoves, and large windows looking out to the street. (9) The video concludes with shots of the restaurant's exterior, including colorful orange and yellow chairs in a patio area and a large red sign with the brand name in Chinese and English.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food review for a sukiyaki hotpot buffet named 'Duo Guo' (二鍋) located in Nanzih, Kaohsiung. It highlights the affordable pricing (starting under $350), the extensive variety of over 50 buffet items, and the premium meat options available in the higher-tier sets to entice viewers to visit.
